reviews.text: Unable to login. Can’t even log into the app. It asks for my email address. I enter it and press the yellow log in button. Then it takes me to another screen asking how I want to receive my verification code. I am able to choose email or text but there isn’t a button to send or continue. It just stays stuck on that screen. So I cannot log in.
Guess pass. It’s so annoying when I try to use my guess passes. It’s not working about three months ago.

Works fine but notifications are super late, app support doesn’t work. As the title says, the app works great to book classes. However, notifications for upcoming classes have been occurring only after the class happens as late as several hours later. The same is happening for friends booking classes. I try to submit a ticket through the app support and it continuously gives me an error message saying it is unable to create a support ticket. The app is up-to-date in my phone, as is my phone up-to-date. I have tried both through Wi-Fi and through cellular data. Nothing solves the issue.
